findings.explanation: HOL4's definition has no type annotations, and nothing in it constrains tvs, tn or id. Its type is (mlstring,mlstring,mlstring list # t) namespace -> num -> ('a # 'b # (mlstring # ast_t list) list) list -> 'c list -> (stamp # 'a # t list # 'c) list. Lean fixes 'a = List tvarN, 'b = mlstring and 'c = type_ident (Nat). So the Lean constant is one instance of the HOL4 constant, and mem_type_def_to_ctMap (line 715) and type_def_to_ctMap_mem (line 740) are special cases of HOL4's polymorphic theorems (script lines 1512 and 1594). Only ctMap_ok_type_defs forces these types. Elsewhere the translation keeps such polymorphism (ctors_of_tdef, fupdate2_union).
findings.repair:
def type_def_to_ctMap {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {γ : Type w} (tenvT : Namespace modN typeN (List tvarN × Ty)) :
    Nat → List (α × β × List (conN × List ast_t)) → List γ → List (stamp × (α × List Ty × γ))
  | _, [], [] => []
  | next_stamp, (tvs, _, ctors) :: tds, i :: ids =>
    type_def_to_ctMap tenvT (next_stamp + 1) tds ids ++
    REVERSE (MAP (fun cnts =>
      (.TypeStamp cnts.1 next_stamp, (tvs, MAP (type_name_subst tenvT) cnts.2, i))) ctors)
  | _, _, _ => ARB
-- and generalise mem_type_def_to_ctMap / type_def_to_ctMap_mem over {α β γ}, with x : α × List Ty × γ, tds : List (α × β × List (conN × List ast_t)), ids : List γ
